name: Agent Trace Eval Replay
description: Workflow for replaying agent traces, grading tool decisions, building regression fixtures, and proving prompt/tool improvements.

chain.step: Locate the authoritative trace, session, fixture, test, or feedback entry.
Read only the trace windows, metadata, prompts, tool calls, and outputs needed for the evaluation.
Classify routing, tool selection, evidence quality, completion discipline, safety, and user alignment.
Create or update a regression fixture when the failure is durable and reproducible.
Store a bounded lesson only when it is stable and future-useful.
